sentences.text:
"Wherefore, it is most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to quash the impugned charge sheet bearing no. 1 dated 16-01-2024 as well as summoning order dated 30-03-2024 passed in Criminal Case No. 34461/2024 arising out of Case Crime No. 204 of 2023 under section 4984,323,504,506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Nagram, District- Lucknow, pending before the Court of ACJM IV,
Lucknow against the petitioners contained as Annexure No. 1 and 2 to this petition.

Further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to quash the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No. 34461/2024 arising out of Case Crime No. 204 of 2023 under section 498A,323,504,506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Nagram, District- Lucknow pending before the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate IV, Lucknow, as well as the summoning order dated 30-03-2024 as those legally barred by exercising the inherent power as provided to this Hon'ble Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C. Now section 528 B.N.S.S. in the interest of justice."
It appears that after considering the averments made in the Application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. No.1340 of 2025 and the documents in support thereof as also the submissions made by the learned counsel for the applicants, this Court vide order dated 13.02.2025 referred the matter to the concerned court for the purpose of verification of the compromise entered into between the parties.
It appears from the order dated 20.02.2025 (Annexure No.4) that the trial court has verified the compromise, mentioning therein that the parties were present and they have admitted that they have entered into an agreement voluntarily and their signatures have been verified by their respective counsels before the court.
Considering the aforesaid as also the submissions made by learned Counsel for the parties as also the observations made by Apex Court in the case of State of Karnataka Vs. L. Muniswamy and Others, 1977 (2) SCC 699; State of Haryana Vs. Bhajan Lal and Others, 1992 Supp (1) SCC 335;
Prashant Bharti Vs. State (NCT of Delhi), (2013) 9 SCC 293; Rajiv Thapar and Ors. Vs. Madan Lal Kapoor, (2013) 3 SCC 330; Ahmad Ali Quraishi and Ors. Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh and Ors.
